applyTo: "samples/**/README.md"

# Sample README conventions

Keep sample READMEs short and focused on running the sample: what it does,
prerequisites, minimal setup, verification, and safe rollback or cleanup.
Describe only the capabilities and limitations needed to use this sample.
Move exhaustive runtime feature lists, architecture, rollout status, and
qualification discussions to the appropriate `docs/` page or PR description.
